children: ICICI Securities's research report on LG Electronics India

In Q2FY27, LG Electronics India (LG) reported its highest-ever revenue growth, supported by broad-based demand across categories. We note: (1) EBITDA margin expanded 63bps YoY, driven by richer premium mix and operating leverage, despite elevated commodity prices, and higher GTM investments. (2) LG's two-track strategy of premiumisation and Essential Series expansion continues to gain traction, with new categories such as Chest Freezers and French Door Refrigerators further strengthening its portfolio. (3) The company is also expanding beyond traditional consumer electronics through exports, B2B and AMC, with its entry into Vehicle Solutions marking another step towards diversification. (4) Management reiterated its
FY27 targets of mid-teen revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin.

We model LG to report revenue and PAT CAGRs of 14.4% and 19.7%, respectively, over FY26–28E. Maintain BUY with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 2,100 (earlier INR 1,815; implied target P/E at 59x FY28E EPS).
